title: RedisExcel configuration
description: Schema for RedisExcel.json. Comments (// and /* */) are accepted by the loader. Values that do not match are dropped individually (the rest of the file is kept).

host.description: Default Redis host for RTD (host:port or a full connection string).

timeout.description: Connect and sync timeout in milliseconds.

RedisUpdateRateMs.description: How often the poll timer reads Redis.

ExcelUpdateRateMs.description: How often dirty values are flushed to Excel.

MessageCounterThreshold.description: Messages/second above which Automatic switches to timer delivery.

UseGetMultiple.description: Batch polled GET/HGET reads into one round trip.

host.description: Default Redis host for the UDF functions.

timeout.description: Connect and sync timeout in milliseconds.

UpdateCheck.description: Check GitHub for a newer release in the background.

SkipRepeatedMessages.description: Skip identical consecutive payloads for literal SUB and polled GET/HGET.

CoalesceRealtimeUpdates.description: Legacy real-time coalescing flag (superseded by an explicit ConflationMs).

ConflationMs.description: Real-time conflation window in ms (0 = off, one push per message; negative clamps to 0, >3600000 caps to 3600000 via Sanitize).

PublishDedupCacheSize.description: Capacity of the PublishIfChanged dedup cache (LRU).

AsyncWrites.description: Dispatch writes through Excel-DNA async so the Excel thread never blocks.
